title: Readout from Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with Japanese Minister of Finance Satsuki Katayama
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama on April 15, 2026, discussing energy, financial issues, and the strong US-Japan alliance. The readout references Prime Minister Takaichi's recent US visit and Assistant Secretary Pilkerton's CFIUS engagements. The Treasury pledged support for Japan's development of its own investment screening mechanism.
